decisions.reason: As software for process data archiving and reporting that is very close to the firm's existing automation and digital infrastructure capabilities, it fits the firm's data-driven direction and can likely be improved and commercialised effectively through its strong in-house R&D and research links.

Because flow measurement automation and system software builds directly on the firm's established control, software and infrastructure know-how and supports its move toward connected, predictive operations, management would be inclined to retain it and learn from further deployment rather than withdraw it.
